Alex / Jasmine —

I reviewed the sandbox instructions. A couple quick heads-up for PayLane’s infra lead:
- Expect transient egress to our metrics endpoint; allowlist metrics.redwood-internal.net.
- For the prompt set, plan for ~0.7–1.1s p95 on an rtx-backed instance for 256-token requests. If you see >2s regularly, flag and send logs.
- If you’re pulling a customer dataset, ensure PII is masked in the sample runs.

I attached a tiny perf snippet with a sample curl and token headers you can paste into your infra tests.

I’ll be on the Tue 10/20 2:00pm PT sync to run through any results quickly.
